ex.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
ex.zh: 他買的第一樣東西是鬧鐘。

ex.en: I called customer service because they sent me the wrong item.
ex.zh: 我打電話給客服，因為他們寄錯商品給我。

ex.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.
ex.zh: 無人認領的物品被拍賣掉了。

ex.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
ex.zh: 我們繼續進行議程上的事項吧。

ex.en: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?
ex.zh: 你檢查過購物清單上的所有項目了嗎？

ex.en: I have an itch in my ear.
The mosquito bite gave me a terrible itch.
ex.zh: 蚊子叮的地方癢得要命。

ex.en: This wool sweater makes my skin itch.
ex.zh: 這件羊毛衣讓我的皮膚發癢。

ex.en: Each iteration improved the software design.
ex.zh: 每次迭代都讓軟體設計更完善。

ex.en: The final iteration passed all the tests.
ex.zh: 最後一輪反覆修正通過了所有測試。

ex.en: Everyone agrees to stay here for the night and make long-term itinerary decisions tomorrow.
ex.zh: 大家同意先在這裡住一晚，行程的事情明天再從長計議。

ex.en: I'll email you the itinerary for our trip to Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我會把東京之旅的行程用電子郵件寄給你。
